method.01.title: Start with context.
method.01.description: Understand how the market is moving before choosing a direction. I look at structure, key levels and the broader picture.
method.02.title: Find the areas that matter.
method.02.description: Identify where liquidity may sit and which zones deserve attention. A level is a place to prepare a scenario, not a promise of a reversal.
method.02.note: A level is a point of interest.
method.03.title: Know both sides of the idea.
method.03.description: Define what would support the trade and what would invalidate it. Every setup needs a clear reason to enter—and a reason to step away.
method.04.title: Size the risk before the position.
method.04.description: Set a risk limit, consider position size and keep the plan under review. Follow-up matters as much as the initial idea.
method.04.note: Risk is part of the plan.
